# AudioServiceExtensions

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Audio` · class

```csharp
public static class AudioServiceExtensions
```

Toolkit extensions for [`AudioService`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/AudioService.md) that accept [`SoundSegment`](SoundSegment.md)s.

## Methods

### CreateVoice

```csharp
public static SoundVoice CreateVoice(this AudioService audioService, SoundSegment segment)
```

Types: [`SoundVoice`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SoundVoice.md), [`AudioService`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/AudioService.md), [`SoundSegment`](SoundSegment.md)

Creates a pre-allocated voice that plays the given segment. The segment's `(offset, duration)` is baked into the voice at construction time so subsequent [`SoundVoice.Play`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SoundVoice.md#play) calls remain allocation-free.
